# sequence feature type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sequenceFeatureType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind(s) of a sequence feature (one or more [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md) individuals). Non-functional: multi-source classifications may differ (a feature classified as both 'gene' and 'pseudogene' by different sources) and must coexist as evidence ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) -> [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md) from [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md) to [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md), [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to classify a sequence feature by one or more [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md) values; non-functional, so multi-source classifications coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid encoding the type as a subclass (gene-vs-pseudogene disagreements coexist, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Attach one or more [`gmeow:SequenceFeatureType`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeatureType.md) individuals to the [`SequenceFeature`](../classes/gmeow-SequenceFeature.md).

### Examples

- ex:brca1 [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureType`](gmeow-sequenceFeatureType.md) [`gmeow:sequenceFeatureTypeGene`](../individuals/gmeow-sequenceFeatureTypeGene.md).
